acceptance_predicates.description: Configuration/default, credential reference, recording mode, and replay policy use typed bounded controls on the supported wizard path.
The authoritative supported fresh-user route completes with zero free-form characters and at most 24 total key events, with categorized regression evidence.
Selections preserve exact provider, model, configuration, credential-reference name, recording mode, replay policy, generation, and digest through the existing control request without fallback.
Every changed screen, element, action, and transition appears in the executable formal model, source inventory, and UI ownership declarations, and CI rejects drift.
Every changed control and performable action has meaningful context-specific help and visible keyboard guidance validated by CI.
No credential value, raw provider payload, prompt, or private path enters TUI state or evidence; missing development authentication, signatures, and key management remain warning-only.

definition_of_done: Focused controls, renderer, navigation, persistence, cancellation, formal-model, ownership, help, stale-selection, codec, and privacy tests pass.
An exact-head authoritative journey satisfies the zero-free-form and total-action bounds without documentation lookup.
Independent review, required hosted checks, signed/DCO merge, exact-main post-merge checks, and a privacy-safe receipt pass.

inputs.description: Independently reviewed AR-1597 receipt identifying 122 free-form characters across four supported-path fields.
Exact dynamic provider/model catalog, typed selection, revision, and digest contracts delivered through AR-1720.

outputs.description: Typed selection controls and safe defaults for all four formerly free-form supported-path fields.
Privacy-safe exact-head evidence reporting categorized navigation, selection, and free-form action counts.

gates.description: The authoritative supported wizard journey uses zero free-form characters and no more than 24 total key events.
Formal model, source inventory, UI ownership, and contextual-help completeness gates pass for every changed control.
Credential values, prompts, raw provider payloads, and private paths are absent from state, output, logs, and evidence.
